feeds.title: Doubtnut Blogs » JEE
feeds.description: Doubtnut is an Indian educational platform started by Tanushree Nagori and Aditya Shankar in 2016. The platform uses image recognition technologies to provide solutions for Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and other subjects. To find the solution to a question, you just have to upload an image of the question. Here readers can find helpful and informative articles and solutions to JEE questions.
